subject: docs/coop/artifacts/deferral.DR-108.preview.v2.json
reviewClass: independent, refute not confirm; D-001/D-002 explicit-deferral candidate
summary: The commission reproduces D-002's own parenthetical for this row, the owner string matches file 08 character-for-character, and the deferral is bounded at both ends — a re-entry clause and a condition-2 effect that both refuse to cover a later credential-requiring slice. Of the five candidates this is the one that states its own limits most completely.
whatIVerified: Subject digest at start and end: 225be4f985889b421b6d3a132c33a8aec924866f54401dd812d9db662fcd9beb, three measurements at the start and two at the close, equal to the dispatched value, -r--r--r-- throughout. The prompt held at 6a46241c… across start and end.

The commission is D-002's, not the drafter's. D-002's explicit-deferrals paragraph names 'DR-108 (no credential-requiring features in slice 1)', and the artifact's commission and decision reproduce exactly that scope — 'The preview has no stored-credential feature.' The paragraph's own framing, 'each gets its recorded disposition, never silence', is the D-001 condition-2 rule the commission cites.

The attack 'coordinator pretending to be owner' fails on the strongest surface of the five. ownerWhoMustRecord reads 'Security + platform owners (file 08 DR-108). Coordinator may draft. D-000 does not make the coordinator those owners.' I checked the owner string against the register rather than accepting it: file 08's DR-108 owner cell reads 'Security + platform owners', matching character-for-character. The effect clause is conditional throughout — condition2EffectIfOwnerRecorded, and reversibility 'Total before owner recording'.

The attack 'silent SATISFIED' fails: status is CANDIDATE-NOT-RECORDED, binds NOTHING, sealRecommendation DO-NOT-SEAL, reviewStatus AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW, and both SATISFIED occurrences are refusals — 'Does not mark DR-108 SATISFIED' and 'Does not SATISFY the row'. DR-108's live lead label is OPEN and this artifact does not touch it.

The attack 'pulls deferred surface into preview' fails. whatMayBeDesigned admits one item, 'Preview analyze/doctor that do not store credentials and do not require a keychain', which is narrower than the deferral rather than an exception to it, and whatMustNotBePretendedSettled holds the platform threat model, keychain and secure-file migration/recovery, and stored-secret redaction tests outside.

The deferral bounds itself, which is what stops a slice-scoped disposition from being read as permanent. The reentry clause states that a later credential-requiring feature re-opens DR-108 as OPEN for that slice and 'this deferral does not cover it', and the condition-2 effect repeats it.
The attacks 'authorizing implementation', 'amending D-002' and 'file 08 edited' all fail: whatThisDoesNotDo refuses all three explicitly, and file 08 measures 45dc4611… unmodified in my working tree.

The attack 'stale recordedInputs' fails. COORD 4ec069882b41ab5e14668e86cfac8dd977ac850c495c9f4f2ccadf05be107f20 and file 08 45dc4611717276c1f1c275982aa7ce787b2fa0b8fffbe1d315e8cb83ddff2206 both equal live bytes at the start and again at the close, and the remeasuredAfter marker resolves: f7ce35ff0eb310c731b93060775c8ef69b0d36e4 is 'D-093: record committed host-effect-authorization.v8 candidate'.
The frozen v1 predecessor is unedited: deferral.DR-108.preview.v1.json hashes 76c3d0b77facee37f8842cce2e7bb5f10149a7ab704d9333df6cc520da78144b, matching predecessorSha256.
I wrote one file, the verdict named for me, and edited and committed nothing.
whatIDidNotCheck: The Codex review of this subject. Not read.
Whether deferring DR-108 is the right product call. D-002 made that choice; this review tests whether the artifact records it honestly and within scope.
Whether the preview's analyze/doctor surfaces in fact store no credentials. That is an implementation property; I verified the artifact claims it as a design constraint rather than as evidence.
The other four deferral candidates, which are reviewed in their own verdict files.

environment.measurementTool: shasum -a 256 of all five subjects and the prompt three times at the start and twice at the close, with ls -l for permissions; extraction and whitespace-unwrapping of D-002's explicit-deferrals and Platforms paragraphs from COORD to test each commission against its source; column-parse of file 08 for the DR-108 owner cell and lead label; sha256 of the frozen v1 predecessor against predecessorSha256; git log at full hash for the remeasuredAfter commit; structured comparison across all five candidates for re-entry and later-slice bounds

acceptNote: ACCEPT at zero blockers and zero advisories. The test that matters for a deferral is whether it can be read later as covering more than the slice it was written for, and this one closes that off twice — in the reentry clause and again in the condition-2 effect. The owner sentence is also the most careful of the five, naming the file-08 owners, permitting the coordinator only to draft, and stating plainly that D-000 does not make the coordinator those owners.
